objective: Build and prove real DIGITAL WORK adapters and connectors with an honest capability lifecycle: DISCOVERED -> PROBING -> READY -> ACTIVE (or BLOCKED / NOT_READY / NOT_TESTED / DEGRADED / SUSPENDED / REVOKED). ACTIVE requires canonical system identity, canonical account/target identity, actual usable interface, credential brokerage (no secrets in prompts/logs/evidence), deterministic authorization, scoped capabilities, expiry/revocation, cost/quota/rate control, before-state, idempotent execution, system/provider receipt, after-state inspection, reconciliation, compensation where possible, STOP behavior, fault behavior, and independent verification. Digital work domains: files, applications, browser, Git, repositories, deployment, services, communication, calendar. Use owner-controlled bounded canary targets. Fakes may test contracts but cannot prove real provider readiness. Financial actions remain outside scope and must remain denied. Unavailable connectors must not stop unrelated progress.

governed_proving_area.purpose: All real effects run in isolated proving areas/clones under C:\Users\b\AppData\Local\Temp\jarvis-r9-*; canary targets are owner-controlled bounded local resources (local git repos, local files, local service ports on ephemeral test ports); no live daemon, database, vault, protected main, or owner project in place is touched.
governed_proving_area.privacy_boundary: Evidence records identities, hashes, timestamps, provenance, capability states, and non-sensitive excerpts only; credentials are stored only in the brokerage store outside evidence with redacted fingerprints; never any secret in prompts/logs/evidence.
canary_domains: files (local canary directory tree with before/after hashes)
git/repositories (isolated canary clones with real commits and receipts)
services (ephemeral local HTTP service on a test port with health/lifecycle)
browser (bounded local interface probe only if a driver is available; otherwise NOT_TESTED)
communication/calendar (BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED unless a real configured provider is available; no mock claims)

mandatory_deliverables.detail: New additive module(s) under src/jarvis_foundry/capabilities_live/** (do not touch existing kernel/capabilities) implementing a capability registry: discover, probe, mark READY, activate, suspend, revoke; every transition durable in the kernel ledger with events; ACTIVE only after real proof; BLOCKED/NOT_READY/NOT_TESTED/DEGRADED/SUSPENDED/REVOKED recorded honestly with reasons.

mandatory_deliverables.item: Credential brokerage with no secret leakage
mandatory_deliverables.detail: A brokerage that stores credentials with canonical identity, expiry, revocation, scoped capability bindings, and redacted fingerprints only in evidence; retrieval is deterministic and authorized; no secret ever appears in prompts, logs, gate evidence, or manifests (secret scan must pass over all R9-owned artifacts).

mandatory_deliverables.item: Real digital work adapter(s) proven ACTIVE on a canary target
mandatory_deliverables.detail: At least one REAL adapter proven ACTIVE against an owner-controlled bounded canary: real interface, real effect with before/after state, idempotent execution, system receipt, after-state inspection, reconciliation, STOP behavior, and fault behavior (e.g., local git adapter performing a real bounded commit/revert with receipts, or a files adapter with hashed before/after, or a services adapter driving an ephemeral local HTTP lifecycle).

mandatory_deliverables.item: Contract fakes that prove fail-closed contract behavior
mandatory_deliverables.detail: Fake adapter(s) that fail closed: missing credential -> BLOCKED; expired/revoked -> REFUSED; quota/rate exceeded -> deferred; malformed provider receipt -> not accepted; unknown account/target -> refused; financial action -> always denied (no code path, no capability).

Evidence per capability: discovered -> probed -> ready -> active with before-state, after-state, receipt, reconciliation; and at least one suspend/revoke or refusal path with durable record; unavailable connectors recorded as BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED without blocking other gates.
Command/output evidence, hashes, capability states, costs/quotas where applicable, and the exact next autonomous action; every claim carries evidence.

mandatory_gates.gate: Lifecycle honesty: every capability has a durable state; ACTIVE only with real proof (before/after + receipt + reconciliation); BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED recorded honestly.
Credential safety: no secret in any prompt/log/evidence/manifest; secret scan over all R9-owned artifacts passes; brokerage enforces expiry/revocation/scoping.
Real canary effect: at least one adapter produced a real bounded digital effect on an owner-controlled canary with receipt and after-state inspection, idempotently re-executable.
Fail-closed: malformed/absent credentials, expired/revoked, quota/rate exceeded, unknown target, malformed receipt, and financial actions all refuse with durable records and no partial effects.
Independent verification: no builder certifies its own work; a fresh verifier reproduces the lifecycle, the real canary effect, and the fail-closed paths.
No live/protected mutation: canary effects only in proving areas; evidence under 8 MiB; full repo suite green; ruff check + format --check + mypy strict + bandit clean for R9-owned source.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: R9-D01..D06 each PASS with non-empty evidence (paths, hashes, receipts, command outputs).
Capability lifecycle is durable and honest; ACTIVE only with real proof; unavailable connectors are BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED without blocking progress.
Credential brokerage: no secrets in evidence; expiry/revocation/scoping enforced; deterministic authorization.
At least one real adapter ACTIVE with idempotent real canary effect, receipt, after-state, reconciliation.
Fail-closed contract paths proven (including financial denial); no partial effects on refusal.
Cost/quota/rate control enforced where applicable; STOP behavior proven.
Full repository suite green; R9-owned files pass ruff check/format/mypy strict/bandit; evidence under budget; no protected mutation.
Fresh independent verifier reproduces every criterion and finds no new S1/S2 defect.

resources_and_constraints.network_allowed: none for provider calls; real canary effects are local only. Browser/communication/calendar connectors that need real providers are honestly NOT_TESTED/BLOCKED without network.

status_contract: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT_TESTED | WAITING only; exit code zero alone is NOT_TESTED; every PASS needs non-empty evidence.
stop_conditions: any mutation of live/protected state, live vault, live database, protected main, or any owner project in place
any secret value written to evidence, prompts, logs, or manifests
any financial action capability or code path
any fake/mock presented as real provider proof
any ACTIVE claim without before/after state, receipt, and reconciliation
any commit or push by the builder to protected repos
any unrecorded gate failure presented as PASS
